_note: Distributed mode (binary built --features redis). Flow:  harvest push   --config examples/config.distributed.json --reset   (seed once)  ->  run `harvest worker --config …` on N machines/containers  ->  `harvest queue --config …` for depth. Each shard writes its own dataset partition; merge & verify with `harvest export --from out/data/dt=*/part-*.jsonl --to delivery/` (the shell expands the glob; export takes repeated --from paths). Politeness + robots + dedup are shared through Redis, so shards never stack on one host Template note: blog.example.com is a placeholder — a literal run dead-letters on transport (correct behavior). For a local end-to-end demo, point the target start_url at the bundled mock: http://127.0.0.1:8099/index.html (start it: python3 demo/server.py 8099).
